description: Reviewed protocol/auxiliary pattern library for formal-sva. Patterns are templates, not proofs: every instantiated property must cite spec evidence and be reviewed.

patterns.description: When valid is asserted and ready is low, valid and payload must remain stable until handshake.
assumptions: Environment does not drop valid before ready when protocol requires persistence.
limitations: Requires cycle-accurate ready/valid protocol definition in spec.

patterns.description: Payload stable while transfer is pending.

ownership.assume: environment may not push when full unless spec allows

patterns.description: No push when full; or flag behavior as specified.
No pop when empty; or read data invalid as specified.
FIFO ordering/data integrity; usually needs auxiliary scoreboard/reference model.
limitations: unsupported_by_skill unless auxiliary scoreboard/reference model is added and reviewed.

patterns.description: Grant only when request is present unless spec allows parked grant.
Software-visible register readback matches written value subject to field access policy.
limitations: Field side effects, W1C/W1S, and reserved bits require per-field review.

patterns.description: Every accepted transaction produces exactly one completion unless spec states otherwise.
limitations: unsupported_by_skill unless symbolic transaction/scoreboard auxiliary state is modeled.
